description:
The most recently added apps built with AI, newest first.
Use when: the user asks what was shipped recently, with no filter.
Do not use for: filtering by tool or keyword (search_apps); tool and harness changes (whats_new).
Returns: apps[] with the same fields as search_apps.
Limits: limit 1-50, default 10.
Example: {"limit":5}
name: latest_apps
title: Latest apps
